blocks.zh: Best Practices for Handling Glass Vials  |  玻璃藥瓶處理最佳實務
blocks.en: Best Practices for Handling Glass Vials

blocks.zh: 學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解玻璃藥瓶處理過程中損傷風險的來源，以及降低風險的核心原則。
blocks.en: Understand where damage risk arises when handling glass vials, and the core principles for reducing it.

blocks.zh: 掌握 Table 3.0-1🔍 所列的九大處理注意事項，並對應到設備設計與操作面的行動。
blocks.en: Grasp the nine handling considerations listed in Table 3.0-1🔍, and map them to actions in equipment design and operations.

blocks.zh: 了解新設備設計與驗證（Qualification）的協作要求，包含工廠驗收測試（FAT）與現場驗收測試（SAT）。
blocks.en: Understand the collaboration requirements for new equipment design and qualification, including the factory acceptance test (FAT) and site acceptance test (SAT).

blocks.zh: 認識零件尺寸變異（Dimensional Variability）與堆疊公差（Stack-up Tolerance）對處理品質的影響。
blocks.en: Recognize how dimensional variability and stack-up tolerance affect handling quality.

blocks.zh: 了解即時應力監測（Real-Time Stress Monitoring）技術——藥瓶診斷探測器（Vial Diagnostic Drone）的應用場景。
blocks.en: Understand real-time stress monitoring technology, and the use cases for the Vial Diagnostic Drone.

blocks.zh: 3.0 Best Practices for Handling Glass Vials  |  玻璃藥瓶處理最佳實務
blocks.en: 3.0 Best Practices for Handling Glass Vials

blocks.zh: 解說：玻璃容器處理的核心原則
blocks.en: Commentary: core principles of glass container handling

blocks.zh: 核心概念：損傷風險從何而來？
blocks.en: Core concept: where does damage risk come from?

blocks.zh: 玻璃藥瓶在產線上移動時，每一個接觸點都是潛在的損傷來源。PDA TR87 的核心邏輯很簡單：減少摩擦力（friction）與接觸力（force），就能降低刮傷（scratch）、壓痕（bruise）、裂紋（check）、破損（breakage）的發生率。
blocks.en: As glass vials move along the line, every contact point is a potential source of damage. The core logic of PDA TR87 is simple: reduce friction and contact force, and the incidence of scratches, bruises, checks, and breakage falls.

blocks.zh: 這些損傷不只影響外觀——它們可能產生玻璃微粒（glass particles），直接危害注射劑品質與患者安全。
blocks.en: This damage affects more than appearance: it can generate glass particles, directly endangering injectable product quality and patient safety.

blocks.zh: 類比：像搬雞蛋，不像搬磚塊
blocks.en: Analogy: handle them like eggs, not bricks

blocks.zh: 想像你在超市搬運雞蛋：你會輕拿輕放、避免堆疊、不讓雞蛋互相碰撞。玻璃藥瓶的邏輯完全相同，只是規模放大到每分鐘數百支的產線速度。
blocks.en: Imagine carrying eggs in a supermarket: you lift and set them down gently, avoid stacking them, and do not let them knock together. The logic for glass vials is exactly the same, only scaled up to line speeds of hundreds of vials per minute.

blocks.zh: Table 3.0-1🔍 就是這份「搬雞蛋守則」的專業版本，涵蓋從材料選擇到設備設計的九個面向。
blocks.en: Table 3.0-1🔍 is the professional version of this "egg-handling rulebook", covering nine aspects from material selection to equipment design.

blocks.zh: Table 3.0-1🔍 解讀：九大處理考量
blocks.en: Table 3.0-1🔍 interpreted: nine handling considerations

blocks.zh: 限制玻璃對玻璃接觸（Glass-to-Glass Contact）：重力輸送斜坡（ramp）是高風險區——瓶子互撞是最常見的損傷來源之一。最佳解是採用完全避免玻璃互碰的設備設計。
blocks.en: Limit glass-to-glass contact: gravity-fed ramps are a high-risk area, and vials colliding with each other is one of the most common sources of damage. The best solution is an equipment design that avoids glass-to-glass contact altogether.

blocks.zh: 限制玻璃對金屬接觸（Glass-to-Metal Contact）：不銹鋼（stainless steel）硬度遠高於玻璃，會在瓶身留下刮痕。改用聚合物材料如 PTFE、PEEK、UHMWPE 是業界標準做法。
blocks.en: Limit glass-to-metal contact: stainless steel is much harder than glass and leaves scratches on the vial. Switching to polymer materials such as PTFE, PEEK, and UHMWPE is standard industry practice.

blocks.zh: 降低摩擦係數（Friction）：UHMWPE 的摩擦係數極低，適合導軌材料。另一個策略是讓容器「被帶著走」而非「被推著滑行」。
blocks.en: Reduce friction: UHMWPE has a very low coefficient of friction and suits guide-rail materials. Another strategy is to have containers "carried along" rather than "pushed and slid".

blocks.zh: 整體流程管理（Process Management）：頻繁的停起動（stop-start）是背壓與碰撞的主因。「漏斗效應（funneling）」——流道突然變窄——也必須最小化。
blocks.en: Process management: frequent stop-starts are a main cause of back pressure and collisions. "Funneling" (a sudden narrowing of the flow path) must also be minimized.

blocks.zh: 最小化轉換點與積瓶（Transitions & Accumulation）：星形輪（star wheel）、螺旋進瓶器（screw feed）、死板（dead plate）之間的對齊與同步至關重要。
blocks.en: Minimize transitions & accumulation: alignment and synchronization among the star wheel, screw feed, and dead plate are critical.

blocks.zh: 限制背壓（Back Pressure）：無壓迴路儲瓶台（pressureless loop accumulator）或雙向反轉儲瓶台（bi-flow reversing lane accumulator）是先進解決方案。
blocks.en: Limit back pressure: a pressureless loop accumulator or a bi-flow reversing lane accumulator are advanced solutions.

blocks.zh: 評估熱應力（Thermal Stressors）：熱衝擊（thermal shock）可在玻璃內部產生應力裂紋，在滅菌隧道、冷凍乾燥前後特別需要注意。
blocks.en: Evaluate thermal stressors: thermal shock can create stress cracks inside the glass; pay particular attention around sterilizing tunnels and before and after freeze-drying.

blocks.zh: 減緩玻璃破損事件的衝擊（Glass Breakage Events）：防護罩（shielding）、線體清場程序（line clearance）、頻率追蹤——三者缺一不可。
blocks.en: Mitigate the impact of glass breakage events: shielding, line clearance procedures, and frequency tracking; all three are indispensable.

blocks.zh: 調查破損事件（Investigate Breakage Events）：每次破瓶事件都應進行根本原因分析（root cause analysis）並提出 CAPA（矯正預防措施）。
blocks.en: Investigate breakage events: every vial breakage event should undergo root cause analysis and result in a CAPA (corrective and preventive action).

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務注意
blocks.en: CDMO practical note

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，同一條產線可能服務多個客戶、多種瓶型。Table 3.0-1🔍 的原則必須在每次換線（changeover）後重新驗證對齊狀態，不能假設前一批次的設定依然有效。
blocks.en: In a CDMO environment, the same line may serve multiple clients and multiple vial types. The principles in Table 3.0-1🔍 must be re-verified for alignment after every changeover; it cannot be assumed that the previous batch's settings are still valid.

blocks.zh: 特別是「eject bin（退瓶桶）」的使用——許多 CDMO 為節省人力而讓瓶子從退瓶桶回到產線，這個動作本身就是損傷風險。TR87 明確建議改用 eject lane（退瓶通道）。
blocks.en: The use of the eject bin in particular: to save labor, many CDMOs return vials from the eject bin to the line, and this action is itself a damage risk. TR87 explicitly recommends using an eject lane instead.

blocks.zh: 3.1 New Equipment Design, Installation, and Qualification  |  新設備設計、安裝與驗證
blocks.en: 3.1 New Equipment Design, Installation, and Qualification

blocks.zh: 解說：新設備的三方協作驗證
blocks.en: Commentary: three-party collaboration in qualifying new equipment

blocks.zh: 三方協作（Joint Activity）的重要性
blocks.en: The importance of joint activity

blocks.zh: TR87 強調，新設備的設計與驗證必須是三方共同參與的活動：
blocks.en: TR87 stresses that the design and qualification of new equipment must be an activity in which all three parties participate:

blocks.zh: 藥廠 / CDMO：提供製程需求、產品規格
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical company / CDMO: provides process requirements and product specifications

blocks.zh: 設備供應商（Machine Supplier）：提供設備設計能力與限制
blocks.en: Machine supplier: provides equipment design capability and its limitations

blocks.zh: 包裝材料供應商（Container/Closure Manufacturer）：提供藥瓶的尺寸規格與公差範圍
blocks.en: Container/closure manufacturer: provides vial dimensional specifications and tolerance ranges

blocks.zh: 三方若不協作，最常見的結果是：設備設計時採用「理想尺寸」，但實際批次的瓶子尺寸變異導致卡瓶或破瓶。
blocks.en: If the three parties do not collaborate, the most common result is that the equipment is designed around "ideal dimensions", but dimensional variability in actual lots of vials causes jams or breakage.

blocks.zh: 類比：FAT / SAT 就像新車的試駕驗收
blocks.en: Analogy: FAT / SAT are like a test drive when accepting a new car

blocks.zh: 工廠驗收測試（Factory Acceptance Test, FAT）在設備製造商廠內進行，確認設備在理想條件下正常運作。現場驗收測試（Site Acceptance Test, SAT）在藥廠現場進行，確認設備在實際環境中符合要求。
blocks.en: The Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) is performed at the equipment manufacturer's site to confirm that the equipment runs correctly under ideal conditions. The Site Acceptance Test (SAT) is performed at the pharmaceutical site to confirm that the equipment meets requirements in the actual environment.

blocks.zh: 就像買新車要先在試駕場開，再到山路、高速公路上實際驗證性能——兩個場景缺一不可。
blocks.en: It is like buying a new car: you first drive it on the test track, then verify its performance on mountain roads and highways. Neither scenario can be skipped.

blocks.zh: 為什麼要測「最大速度」AND「最小速度」？
blocks.en: Why test at both maximum AND minimum speed?

blocks.zh: 最大速度：確認設備在高速下不產生過大的衝擊力、背壓或夾瓶點（pinch point）應力。
blocks.en: Maximum speed: confirms that at high speed the equipment does not generate excessive impact force, back pressure, or pinch point stress.

blocks.zh: 最小速度：速度過慢時，某些機構（如螺旋進瓶器）可能因扭矩（torque）不足或同步失調而造成瓶子卡住。
blocks.en: Minimum speed: when running too slowly, some mechanisms (such as the screw feed) may jam vials because of insufficient torque or loss of synchronization.

blocks.zh: 換言之，操作窗口（operating window）的上下限都必須驗證，不能只測中間值。
blocks.en: In other words, both the upper and lower limits of the operating window must be verified; testing only the midpoint is not enough.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：FAT/SAT 查核清單重點
blocks.en: Practical application: key points for an FAT/SAT checklist

blocks.zh: 準備代表性的瓶子樣品，涵蓋尺寸公差的上限、下限、中間值（最差條件）
blocks.en: Prepare representative vial samples covering the upper limit, lower limit, and midpoint of the dimensional tolerances (worst case)

blocks.zh: 測試所有計畫使用的瓶型尺寸（不只主力規格）
blocks.en: Test all vial sizes planned for use (not only the main format)

blocks.zh: 在 FAT 時要求設備供應商展示夾瓶點分析（pinch point analysis）
blocks.en: At FAT, require the equipment supplier to demonstrate a pinch point analysis

blocks.zh: 記錄所有測試時的線速、停機事件、破瓶數量，作為基線數據
blocks.en: Record the line speed, stoppage events, and number of broken vials during all tests as baseline data

blocks.zh: 3.2 Considerations of Component Design and Variation  |  零件設計與變異的考量
blocks.en: 3.2 Considerations of Component Design and Variation

blocks.zh: 解說：尺寸變異與公差堆疊
blocks.en: Commentary: dimensional variation and tolerance stack-up

blocks.zh: 兩種變異需要關注
blocks.en: Two kinds of variation need attention

blocks.zh: 批次間變異（Lot-to-Lot Variability）：不同批次的藥瓶，即使來自同一供應商，外徑、肩部角度、底部平整度都可能有所不同。如果設備只針對一批樣品調校，換批後可能立即出現問題。
blocks.en: Lot-to-lot variability: even from the same supplier, vials from different lots may differ in outer diameter, shoulder angle, and base flatness. If the equipment is tuned only to one lot of samples, problems may appear immediately after a lot change.

blocks.zh: 瓶間變異（Vial-to-Vial Variability）：同一批次中，個別瓶子的尺寸也有差異。設備設計必須能容忍這個自然變異，而不是只能處理「完美尺寸」的瓶子。
blocks.en: Vial-to-vial variability: within the same lot, individual vials also differ in size. The equipment design must tolerate this natural variation, rather than being able to handle only "perfectly sized" vials.

blocks.zh: 公差堆疊（Stack-up Tolerance）概念
blocks.en: The concept of stack-up tolerance

blocks.zh: 當藥瓶（vial）、塞子（stopper）、鋁蓋（seal）組合在一起時，每個零件的公差會累加：
blocks.en: When the vial, stopper, and seal are assembled together, the tolerance of each component accumulates:

blocks.zh:
總高度變異 = 瓶身高度公差
           + 塞子厚度公差
           + 鋁蓋壓合後的尺寸變異

例：
  瓶身高度：±0.3 mm
  塞子厚度：±0.2 mm
  封蓋變形：±0.1 mm
  ─────────────────
  最差情況總變異：±0.6 mm
blocks.en:
Total height variation = vial height tolerance
           + stopper thickness tolerance
           + dimensional variation after seal crimping

Example:
  Vial height: ±0.3 mm
  Stopper thickness: ±0.2 mm
  Seal deformation: ±0.1 mm
  ─────────────────
  Worst-case total variation: ±0.6 mm

blocks.zh: 這 0.6 mm 的變異若未被設備設計納入考量，可能導致壓蓋不完全或夾瓶。
blocks.en: If this 0.6 mm of variation is not taken into account in the equipment design, it may lead to incomplete capping or pinched vials.

blocks.zh: 技術圖面（Technical Drawing）的細節很重要
blocks.en: Details in the technical drawing matter

blocks.zh: TR87 特別點名幾個在技術圖面上容易被忽略的規格：
blocks.en: TR87 specifically names several specifications that are easily overlooked on technical drawings:

blocks.zh: 肩部角度（Shoulder Angle）：影響星形輪對瓶子的夾持方式
blocks.en: Shoulder angle: affects how the star wheel grips the vial

blocks.zh: 半徑（Radius）：圓角半徑影響導軌接觸面積
blocks.en: Radius: the corner radius affects the contact area with the guide rail

blocks.zh: 同心度（Concentricity）：瓶身是否真正圓心對準，影響旋轉式設備的穩定性
blocks.en: Concentricity: whether the vial body is truly centered affects the stability of rotary equipment

blocks.zh: 圓度（Roundness）：截面是否接近完美圓形，影響螺旋進瓶器的咬合
blocks.en: Roundness: how close the cross-section is to a perfect circle affects how the screw feed engages

blocks.zh: 供應商提供的圖面若缺乏這些規格，驗證時很難定義「合格」標準。
blocks.en: If the drawings provided by the supplier lack these specifications, it is difficult to define acceptance criteria during qualification.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：量測技術對齊
blocks.en: Practical application: aligning measurement techniques

blocks.zh: TR87 強調「量測技術的對齊（aligning measurement techniques）」——藥廠、設備商、包材商各自量同一支瓶子，若使用不同量具或方法，可能得出不同數字，導致爭議。
blocks.en: TR87 stresses "aligning measurement techniques": if the pharmaceutical company, the equipment supplier, and the packaging supplier each measure the same vial using different gauges or methods, they may obtain different numbers, leading to disputes.

blocks.zh: 建議做法：在專案啟動時，召開三方量測系統分析（MSA）會議，確認量測定義與方法一致。
blocks.en: Recommended practice: at project kickoff, hold a three-party measurement system analysis (MSA) meeting to confirm that measurement definitions and methods are consistent.

blocks.zh: 3.3 Real-Time Stress Monitoring  |  即時應力監測
blocks.en: 3.3 Real-Time Stress Monitoring

blocks.zh: 解說：藥瓶診斷探測器技術
blocks.en: Commentary: Vial Diagnostic Drone technology

blocks.zh: 什麼是 Vial Diagnostic Drone（藥瓶診斷探測器）？
blocks.en: What is a Vial Diagnostic Drone?

blocks.zh: 這是一種外觀類似普通藥瓶、但內部嵌有感測器的智慧型裝置。它被放入正常的藥瓶流中，隨著產線移動，同時記錄並即時傳輸以下數據：
blocks.en: It is a smart device that looks like an ordinary vial but has sensors embedded inside. It is placed in the normal vial flow and moves along with the line, recording and transmitting the following data in real time:

blocks.zh: Line Pressure（線壓）：瓶子在積瓶區或轉換點所承受的側向壓力
blocks.en: Line pressure: the lateral pressure vials experience in accumulation zones or at transition points

blocks.zh: Shock Events（衝擊事件）：瓶子碰撞或跌落時的瞬間加速度
blocks.en: Shock events: the instantaneous acceleration when vials collide or fall

blocks.zh: 溫度變化（某些型號）：用於評估熱應力
blocks.en: Temperature changes (some models): used to evaluate thermal stress

blocks.zh: 這些數據不再需要等待破瓶或外觀檢查才能發現問題，而是在損傷發生之前就診斷出高風險區域。
blocks.en: With these data, problems no longer have to wait for vial breakage or visual inspection to be found; high-risk areas are diagnosed before damage occurs.

blocks.zh: 類比：給產線做「心電圖」
blocks.en: Analogy: an "ECG" for the production line

blocks.zh: 傳統方式是事後解剖——等瓶子破了才查原因。Vial Diagnostic Drone 的概念更像是給產線戴上連續心電圖監測器：即時看到每個「心跳異常」（衝擊或過壓事件），在「心臟病發作」（大量破瓶）之前採取行動。
blocks.en: The traditional approach is a post-mortem: the cause is investigated only after vials break. The Vial Diagnostic Drone is more like putting a continuous ECG monitor on the line: you see each "abnormal heartbeat" (shock or overpressure event) in real time and act before the "heart attack" (mass vial breakage).

blocks.zh: 應用場景：三大用途
blocks.en: Application scenarios: three main uses

blocks.zh: 現有產線優化：針對已知高破瓶率的製程，用探測器找出具體的高風險點（哪個星形輪？哪個轉彎？），量化後進行針對性改善。
blocks.en: Optimizing existing lines: for processes with a known high breakage rate, use the drone to find the specific high-risk points (which star wheel? which turn?), then quantify them and make targeted improvements.

blocks.zh: 新設備驗收（FAT/SAT）：在工廠驗收測試時，用探測器客觀驗證設備設計是否達到低應力標準，而非僅憑目視觀察。
blocks.en: Acceptance of new equipment (FAT/SAT): during factory acceptance testing, use the drone to verify objectively whether the equipment design meets low-stress standards, rather than relying on visual observation alone.

blocks.zh: 運輸驗證（In Transit）：藥瓶在出貨運輸過程中也可能因震動損傷。探測器可放入貨箱中記錄運輸全程的衝擊數據。
blocks.en: Transport validation (in transit): vials can also be damaged by vibration during shipment. The drone can be placed in the shipping case to record shock data throughout transport.

blocks.zh: 數據驅動的改善循環
blocks.en: The data-driven improvement cycle

blocks.zh: TR87 強調這些即時數據可用於優化：
blocks.en: TR87 stresses that these real-time data can be used to optimize:

blocks.zh: 輸送帶速度（Conveyor Speed）：找到速度與壓力的平衡點
blocks.en: Conveyor speed: find the balance point between speed and pressure

blocks.zh: 格式零件公差（Format Part Tolerances）：依據實測數據調整導軌、星形輪的尺寸
blocks.en: Format part tolerances: adjust the dimensions of guide rails and star wheels based on measured data

blocks.zh: 機器人夾取（Robotic Pickup）：優化機械臂的夾持力道與位置
blocks.en: Robotic pickup: optimize the gripping force and position of robotic arms

blocks.zh: 這代表玻璃藥瓶處理從「憑經驗調整」進入「數據驅動優化」的新時代。對 CDMO 而言，這也是向客戶展示製程能力的有力工具。
blocks.en: This marks a new era in which glass vial handling moves from "adjusting by experience" to "data-driven optimization". For a CDMO, it is also a powerful tool for demonstrating process capability to clients.

blocks.zh: Section 3 重點摘要 — Key Takeaways
blocks.en: Section 3 Key Takeaways

blocks.zh: 核心邏輯：降低摩擦力與接觸力是保護玻璃藥瓶的根本原則，貫穿所有處理環節。
blocks.en: Core logic: reducing friction and contact force is the fundamental principle for protecting glass vials, and it runs through every handling step.

blocks.zh: Table 3.0-1🔍 九大原則：限制玻璃對玻璃接觸、限制玻璃對金屬接觸、降低摩擦係數、整體流程管理、最小化轉換點、限制背壓、評估熱應力、減緩破損衝擊、調查破損事件——這九項原則適用於現有與新設備。
blocks.en: The nine principles of Table 3.0-1🔍: limit glass-to-glass contact, limit glass-to-metal contact, reduce friction, process management, minimize transitions, limit back pressure, evaluate thermal stressors, mitigate the impact of breakage, and investigate breakage events. These nine principles apply to both existing and new equipment.

blocks.zh: 新設備驗證：必須是藥廠、設備商、包材商三方協作，FAT 與 SAT 都需涵蓋所有瓶型與最大/最小速度。
blocks.en: Qualification of new equipment: must be a three-party collaboration among the pharmaceutical company, equipment supplier, and packaging supplier; both FAT and SAT must cover all vial formats and maximum/minimum speeds.

blocks.zh: 尺寸變異：批次間與瓶間的尺寸變異、公差堆疊（瓶+塞+蓋）都必須納入設備設計；技術圖面需包含肩部角度、同心度、圓度等細節規格。
blocks.en: Dimensional variation: lot-to-lot and vial-to-vial variation and stack-up tolerance (vial + stopper + seal) must all be built into the equipment design; technical drawings need to include detailed specifications such as shoulder angle, concentricity, and roundness.

blocks.zh: 即時監測技術：Vial Diagnostic Drone 可即時量測產線壓力與衝擊事件，實現數據驅動的製程優化，並可應用於 FAT/SAT 及運輸驗證。
blocks.en: Real-time monitoring technology: the Vial Diagnostic Drone measures line pressure and shock events in real time, enabling data-driven process optimization, and can be applied to FAT/SAT and transport validation.
